entries.name: Banana protein smoothie with double oats
entries.quantity: 100 g banana, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, 150 mL full-cream milk, 30 g rolled oats, 100–150 mL water and ice
entries.notes: User requested logging after confirming rolled oats doubled from 15 g to 30 g. Other ingredients assumed as suggested, not independently weighed.
